The company operates in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, with a strong focus on innovation, engineering excellence, and continuous professional development.
 Role Overview
 We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team and drive the performance, reliability and scalability of our data platform. This role focuses on Snowflake optimization, pipeline automation and mentoring junior engineers while contributing to key architectural decisions.
 Mandatory Skills
 5+ years of experience in data engineering
 Proficiency in SQL and Python for advanced query writing, optimization and automation
 Expertise in Snowflake, Databricks or Oracle
 Familiarity with AWS or Azure cloud services for data engineering
 Understanding of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or similar tools
 Skills in Apache Airflow and dbt for workflow orchestration and data transformation
 English proficiency at B2 level or higher
 Nice-to-have
 Knowledge of Terraform for infrastructure as code
 Familiarity with Kafka for event streaming and messaging
 Monitor Snowflake health and performance
 Debug and resolve failures in data ingestion or transformation
 Support platform tenants with Snowflake and Apache Airflow-related queries
 Build and maintain an end-to-end testing framework to ensure platform changes don't impact tenant flows across ingestion, transformation and orchestration
 Tune queries and optimize data storage for speed and cost efficiency
 Automate manual steps using GitLab CI/CD pipelines
 Support the release process
 Document data architecture, pipeline processes and best practices
 Collaborate with the Snowflake team to research and adopt new tools or frameworks
 Mentor junior colleagues and support their skill development
 Contribute to architectural decisions around data engineering implementation and tooling
